hero.filename: Sonar Image of Suspected Sidewheel Steamship Pacific 's Paddle Wheels.png
hero.caption: Side scan sonar image created in 2022 showing circular impressions in the seafloor appx. 12 miles west of Cape Flattery, WA. Believed to be the side paddlewheels of the steamboat Pacific, sunk November 4, 1875.
hero.alt: Side scan sonar image created in 2022 showing circular impressions in the seafloor appx. 12 miles west of Cape Flattery, WA. Believed to be the side paddlewheels of the steamboat Pacific, sunk November 4, 1875.

images.caption: Newspaper advertisement for the steamship Pacific captained by Jefferson Davis Howell. Ad appeared two months before the Pacific sank in a collision off the Washington coast.
